title: Zoning text change for housing at 2950 West 24th Street, Brooklyn
summary: This application would amend the Zoning Resolution to establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 2950 West 24th Street in Coney Island, Brooklyn. It is one of four related actions that together would allow an 18-story mixed-use building with 408 income-restricted units, ground-floor community facility and commercial space, and open space. The City Council held a public hearing on the proposal on July 1, 2026.
